en: The postcard features black-and-white illustrations of a building labeled 'Auerhahn Restaurant' and what appears to be the interior of a restaurant or beer hall with patrons and seating visible. There is a decorative motif with a bird (a capercaillie), and banners with German text. Additional signs on the building reference 'J. Hochschmid' and 'Pilsener Bierhalle.' The design style is ornate and period-specific.
